test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_hull_all_vertices_{n} (pt Point) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_hull_all_vertices_{n} SELECT (cos(number * 2 * pi() / {n}), sin(number * 2 * pi() / {n})) FROM numbers({n})
test.query: SELECT groupConvexHull(pt) FROM bench_hull_all_vertices_{n} FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
